rationale: Translate 商談 as negotiations, not a business proposal; preserve the object whose prospects are being assessed.
Separate daughter’s husband/son-in-law from groom in a wedding context.
Naturalize 早朝から and render 捜査の網を張る as coordinated search activity.
Preserve the wing/takeoff metaphor without the awkward “крила у вигляді” construction.
Give the noun its own Ukrainian equivalents; keep adjective forms under 裸の.
Translate the meeting’s ending later than scheduled, not a longer duration.
Specify the anatomical under-arm area while retaining the broader side/outlying-place sense.
Naturalize the enlistment-ceremony translation and the solemn manner of the oath.
Remove the mixed phrase “однобічно суб’єктивною”; express excessive dependence on personal views.
Broaden the definition beyond smiling to likable/cute qualities and behavior.
Display the related spelling as 愛嬌／愛敬 and clarify that it is あいきょう, not a variant of 愛想.
Naturalize the courtesy-visit expression and “relevant offices”.
